text:
maria: Heads-up — starting the large docs migration across /docs (multi-PR). There are 6 open PRs: redirects map, move pages (split into batches), SDK snippets, examples, migration guide, and anchor/link fixes. We need to agree on merge sequencing and CI preview strategy so we don't ship a bunch of broken anchors or 404s. My tentative order: 1) redirects map PR, 2) anchor-fix PR, 3) small move PR batches, 4) SDK/examples, 5) migration guide. Who can review redirects first?

ben: Quick Q — why do redirects first? won't moving pages change preview URLs and make it harder to validate? :thinking_face:

maria: Redirects-first means the old URLs are routed while moves are landing, so live previews (and external links) resolve. If we move first then previews show 404 until redirects are in, which causes flakiness and broken CI checks. Also: anchor fixes should land before the bulk moves so internal anchors don't break in the interim.

ashley: Agree on the window approach. We should do merges outside peak support hours. I can coordinate with SRE to hold scheduled deploys and patch release jobs for the merge window. Suggest PR titles follow a strict pattern: `move: <old> -> <new>` and `redirects: batch-1` to make automation easier.

dev-docs-bot: Preview built for PR #431 — https://deploy-preview-431--docs.redwood.ai — netlify linkcheck passed, basic rendering OK.

ryan: I can take the redirects PRs today. Please tag me on #429 and #431. Also suggest adding a small redirects YAML snippet at repo root to make it explicit for Netlify/next config: 
```yaml
- from: /docs/api/auth
  to: /docs/api/auth-v2
  status: 301
```
That way we can test routing before moves land.

leo: I will run the full linkcheck + anchor-scan locally and on a CI matrix. If it helps I can open a tiny PR that adds the smoke test to the docs pipeline so we catch broken anchors early.

maria: Perfect — plan: I'll schedule the merge window 22:00–23:30 PST tomorrow (low traffic). @ashley please ask SRE to pause scheduled deploys for that window and add a note to release-war-room. @ryan review #429/#431 today, @leo post linkcheck output here. I'll tag reviewers on each split PR and merge redirects first, then anchors, then the small move batches. After each batch I'll run the smoke linkcheck and hand off to QA. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ashley: Sounds good, I'll ping oncall and add the release-war-room note. :white_check_mark:
